scripts.assets:bake: sh -c 'export DIWAN_WORLD=${DIWAN_WORLD:-house-of-wisdom}; B="${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender}"; if [ "$DIWAN_WORLD" = house-of-life ]; then node assets/render-hieroglyphs.mjs && "$B" -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/temple.py -- "$@"; else node assets/render-glyphs.mjs && "$B" -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/trim_bake.py -- "$@" && "$B" -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/armillary.py && "$B" -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/hall.py -- "$@"; fi' --
scripts.assets:figures: sh -c 'B="${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender}"; O=assets/worlds/house-of-life/out; if [ "${DIWAN_WORLD:-house-of-wisdom}" = house-of-life ]; then "$B" -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/figures.py -- --world egypt "$@" && mkdir -p $O/figures && node assets/figures/optimize-figures.mjs $O/raw/figures-egypt.raw.glb $O/figures/figures-egypt.glb; else "$B" -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/figures.py -- "$@" && node assets/figures/optimize-figures.mjs; fi' --
scripts.assets:optimize: sh -c 'O=assets/worlds/${DIWAN_WORLD:-house-of-wisdom}/out; export DIWAN_WORLD=${DIWAN_WORLD:-house-of-wisdom}; if [ "$DIWAN_WORLD" = house-of-life ]; then C=pyramid; else C=armillary; fi; node assets/optimize.mjs $O/raw/hall.raw.glb $O/hall.glb && node assets/optimize.mjs $O/raw/$C.raw.glb $O/$C.glb && node assets/optimize.mjs --lightmap $O/raw/lightmap_golden.png $O/lightmap_golden.ktx2 && node assets/optimize.mjs --lightmap $O/raw/lightmap_dusk.png $O/lightmap_dusk.ktx2'
scripts.assets: npm run assets:layout && npm run assets:bake && npm run assets:optimize
